question: Who is the governor of Reserve Bank of India as of May 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shaktikanta Das**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shaktikanta Das** is the current **governor of the Reserve Bank of India as of May 2023**.
 
• He took charge as the **25th governor of the RBI on December 12, 2018**.
 
• Shaktikanta Das is a retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 1980 batch from the Tamil Nadu cadre.
 
• He has previously served as Secretary in the Department of Economic Affairs and the Department of Revenue in the Ministry of Finance, Government of India.
 
• During his tenure, he has overseen key economic policies and reforms including the implementation of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) and the demonetization drive in 2016.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was established on April 1, 1935**, in accordance with the provisions of the** Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934**.
 
• The central office of the RBI was initially **established in Calcutta but was permanently moved to Mumbai in 1937**.
 
• The RBI is responsible for regulating the issue of banknotes, maintaining monetary stability in India, and operating the currency and credit system of the country to its advantage.
 
• The Governor of the RBI is the chief executive officer of India's central bank and the ex-officio chairperson of its Central Board of Directors.
 
• The RBI plays a crucial role in the development strategy of the Government of India, including the management of the country's foreign exchange and the regulation of financial markets.
